subject: Data Engineering
title: Open-Source Ingestion with Airbyte
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Open-Source Ingestion with Airbyte.

hook.text: Airbyte launched in 2020 as the open-source alternative to Fivetran. Community connectors exploded.

buildup.text: Airbyte provides 300+ connectors and lets anyone build custom ones using a standard protocol.

discovery.text: You can self-host Airbyte for free or use their managed cloud version for convenience.

twist.text: Self-hosting means you own the infrastructure, upgrades, and connector bugs. Free isn't free of effort.

climax.text: Airbyte gives small teams enterprise-grade ingestion without enterprise-grade bills.

punchline.text: Open source. Free to start. You manage the rest.

quiz.question: What is the main trade-off of self-hosting Airbyte?
options: No licensing cost but you manage infrastructure and maintenance
It only supports three data sources
